Sam K.: Nebula Systems joint benchmark kickoff. Aim: quantify perf/W and steady throughput for our 7B profile on their new board. Target window: Tue 09:30 PT. We need owners for telemetry, safe kernel delivery, and embargo timing.
Aria T.: I can do telemetry. Plan: 1s samples with fields (ts, run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens, latency_ms, gpu_watts, pdu_watts). Will post schema to #eng-ml.
Noah P.: Kernel changes will be delivered as a drop-in module under /opt/nebula/mods; include apply/rollback scripts. Will provide signed SBOM and brief threat analysis for Legal.
BenchBot: Reservation confirmed: nebula-lab-4 Tue 09:30-13:30 PT for `nebula_day1_bench`. Use `@BenchBot extend nebula-lab-4 1h` to add time.
Sam K.: Models/datasets: redwood-mini-suite-v4, nebula-open-7b-q4f, redwood-microbench-v3. KV cache off, deterministic seeds. Batch sizes: 1,8,32. Sweep metrics: throughput, latency, perf_per_watt.
Aria T.: Telemetry ingestion path: telemetry-ingest -> topic `nebula_day1`. Will provide example payload and a small CLI for the partner to test by Mon EOD.
LegalBot: Heads up: partner requests a co-announcement. Default embargo 72h internal validation after final run. We'll need partner NDA clause confirmation before publishing.
Noah P.: Add perf/W guard rails: abort run if perf/W regresses >6% vs our baseline tag `baseline/nebula-ref`. Capture full kernel traces on abort.
Sam K.: Standard run command to share with partner:
```bash
./nebula_bench --suite redwood-mini-suite-v4 \
  --models nebula-open-7b-q4f,redwood-mpt-7b-q4 \
  --seq 2048 --batches 1,8,32 \
  --metrics throughput,latency,perf_per_watt \
  --trace kernel:hotpaths --out traces/nebula_day1
```
Aria T.: I'll open the telemetry PR with schema + example payload by Mon EOD.
Noah P.: Module tarball and apply.sh uploaded to /artifacts/nebula/day1-mods.tar.gz by Tue AM.
Sam K.: Action items recap: Aria -> telemetry schema + CLI; Noah -> module package + SBOM + threat notes; Legal -> confirm embargo & NDA item; Sam -> runbook + bench automation. Dry-run Mon 16:00 PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
